nodes.name: ECR expense-dev-app
Aurora expense-dev-cluster
nodes.code:
resource "aws_rds_cluster" "this" {
  cluster_identifier     = "${var.name_prefix}-cluster"
  engine                 = "aurora-postgresql"
  engine_mode            = "provisioned"
  database_name          = "expenses"
  master_username        = "app"
  manage_master_user_password = true
  db_subnet_group_name   = aws_db_subnet_group.this.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.db.id]
  skip_final_snapshot    = true

  serverlessv2_scaling_configuration {
    min_capacity = 0.5
    max_capacity = 2
  }
}

GET /today
nodes.code:
/today:
    get:
      operationId: getToday
      summary: 今日の合計と明細
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Today"

nodes.name: GET /days
nodes.code:
/days:
    get:
      operationId: getDays
      summary: 月の日別合計
      parameters:
        - name: month
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, example: "2026-11" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: { type: integer, format: int64 }

nodes.name: GET /entries

/entries:
    get:
      operationId: getEntries
      summary: 直近の明細
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:

nodes.name: GET /transactions
nodes.code:
/transactions:
    get:
      operationId: listTransactions
      summary: 支出の一覧
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Transaction"

nodes.name: POST /transactions
nodes.code:
/transactions:
    post:
      operationId: createTransaction
      summary: 支出を追加
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/Transaction"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created

nodes.name: DELETE /transactions/{id}
nodes.code:
/transactions/{id}:
    delete:
      operationId: deleteTransaction
      summary: 支出を削除
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "204":
          description: No Content

nodes.name: POST /push/subscriptions
nodes.code:
/push/subscriptions:
    post:
      operationId: subscribePush
      summary: Web Push を購読
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/PushSubscription"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created

nodes.name: DELETE /push/subscriptions
nodes.code:
/push/subscriptions:
    delete:
      operationId: unsubscribePush
      summary: Web Push の購読解除
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/PushSubscription"
      responses:
        "204":
          description: No Content
